Km_epithelial_uM.comment: Km ~160 uM for [3H]KPV uptake via hPepT1 in Caco2-BBE intestinal epithelial cells. Dalmasso 2008 (Gastroenterology, PMID 18061177, DOI 10.1053/j.gastro.2007.10.026), Fig 4C.

Km_immune_uM.comment: Km ~700 uM for [3H]KPV uptake via hPepT1 in Jurkat human T cells. Dalmasso 2008 Fig 5F. Immune-cell PepT1 has ~4x higher Km (lower affinity) than epithelial. This is the closest available immune-cell KPV/PepT1 kinetic anchor; synovial macrophages are NOT characterized.

Km_used_uM.comment: Model uses the IMMUNE-cell Km (700 uM) as the central value because the relevant healthy comparator is a joint macrophage, not an enterocyte. Sensitivity spans 160-1000 uM.

pept1_kpv_kinetics.Vmax_note: Dalmasso 2008 reports Km but not an absolute Vmax convertible to intracellular accumulation ceiling in a synovial macrophage. The healthy-cell accumulation is therefore parameterized by a dimensionless PepT1 expression scenario (see pept1_expression_scenarios) rather than a raw Vmax. THIS IS THE HEADLINE UNCERTAINTY.

pept1_macrophage_expression.status: QUALITATIVELY DEMONSTRATED, QUANTITATIVELY UNCHARACTERIZED IN SYNOVIAL MACROPHAGES
pept1_macrophage_expression.evidence_for: Dalmasso 2008 (PMID 18061177): 'KPV acts via hPepT1 expressed in immune and intestinal epithelial cells'; functional PepT1-mediated [3H]KPV uptake shown in Jurkat T cells. Viennois 2016 (PMID 27458604) and KPV-nanoparticle colitis papers (PMID 39211778, 31408067) repeatedly state KPV targets macrophages via PepT1 overexpressed on inflamed-tissue macrophages.
pept1_macrophage_expression.gap: NO study quantifies PepT1 (SLC15A1) protein/functional expression in SYNOVIAL-JOINT macrophages, resting or MSU-activated. Whether a healthy (non-pyroptotic) synovial macrophage already admits KPV via PepT1 -- and how much -- is unknown. This is the dominant empirical gap for A2; under the heuristic equation, modeled selectivity also varies with C_ext/Km.

pept1_expression_scenarios.comment: Healthy-cell KPV accumulation is represented by a linear-regime accumulation ratio AR_lin = C_in,healthy/C_ext (dimensionless) when C_ext << Km, from which the heuristic C_in_max_healthy = AR_lin * Km is derived. S_model = C_in,pyroptotic / C_in,healthy. These four unweighted design scenarios map equation behavior; they are not physiological estimates.

absent.meaning: zero healthy-cell PepT1 baseline in the heuristic; mathematical ratio is positive infinity, encoded explicitly rather than treated as evidence

low.meaning: low PepT1; healthy cells admit modest KPV

moderate.meaning: heuristic healthy-cell accumulation approaches extracellular concentration in the linear regime

high.meaning: heuristic healthy-cell accumulation exceeds extracellular concentration in the linear regime

kpv_cell_assay_effective_concentration_p.comment: Dalmasso 2008 (PMID 18061177) reports that nanomolar extracellular KPV inhibited NF-kB activation in PepT1-positive cells; 10 nM was the lowest tested concentration reported effective in the cited assay. It was not reported as an intracellular concentration or fitted IC50. comp-042 uses 10 nM as a cross-compartment engineering proxy only. The 1-100 nM range is a design-space band, not a confidence interval. Exceeding it does not establish target engagement, therapeutic timing, or efficacy.
